decisions.reason: The transactional email service is the flagship of the firm's cloud messaging direction, demand keeps growing and its value is being realized, so further commitment is justified rather than abandonment.
Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflow strategy and costs little to maintain, so the option stays open even though no recent evidence has been observed.
Email-to-fax conversion runs on existing infrastructure and serves regulated customers who still use fax, so holding it is cheap despite the slow long-term decline of fax.
The fax optimization feature is close to the core offer and nearly costless, though it is the most likely of the products to be absorbed into the base fax service as fax declines.
Sandbox threat protection fits rising security demand and the firm's security positioning, so its value is more likely to grow than to vanish.
Multi-engine scanning is a low-cost extension of email security that could later be bundled into broader packages, but there is no clear signal yet that would justify dropping it.
